# Point-in-time snapshot of Cropwright's (the labeler frontend's)
# executable HTTP call sites, as of wt-cropwright-integration commit
# 90baa9b on branch feat/backend-integration.
#
# Paths here are PREFIX-STRIPPED (the frontend's literal `/kb/...` prefix
# is removed -- the app-side comparison strips the backend's configured
# `api_prefix` the same way, see test_labeler_route_parity.py) and
# PARAM-NORMALIZED (any `${...}`-interpolated URL segment is written as
# the literal token `{param}`). Deduplicated and sorted.
#
# Regenerate the raw candidate list with:
#   rg -o "/kb/[A-Za-z0-9_./{}$-]+" \
#     /mnt/nvm/repos/wt-cropwright-integration/src/lib/api.ts \
#     /mnt/nvm/repos/wt-cropwright-integration/src/lib/sse.ts \
#     /mnt/nvm/repos/wt-cropwright-integration/src/routes/export/+page.svelte \
#   | sort -u
#
# That one-liner over-matches comments and JSDoc (rg doesn't know Cropwright's
# comment syntax) -- hand-filter against the executable/comment-only split
# audited in docs/design/cropwright_backend_integration_plan.md §1.2 before
# updating this file, then strip the `/kb` prefix, collapse `${...}`
# interpolations to `{param}`, dedupe, and sort. Update this header's commit
# hash when you do.
#
# Excluded on purpose (see KNOWN_GAPS in test_labeler_route_parity.py for
# the authoritative list + reasons -- do not re-add these without removing
# the matching KNOWN_GAPS entry):
#   /export/lpr                    -- proprietary LPR export, never ported
#   /export/lpr/status             -- ditto
#   /gemma/label_batch             -- frontend hasn't renamed to /vlm/label_batch yet (T-C1)
#   /crops/{param}/plate_thumbnail -- frontend's getPlateThumbUrl() fallback hasn't
#                                      picked up the region_thumbnail rename yet (T-B2)
